summary: Tested the new Radar connector chain (Taleo + Avature + Phenom, with UKG regression) end-to-end on preview. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_radar_new_connectors.py (11 tests, 11/11 PASS in 42 s). Covers (1) POST /api/careeros/radar/portal/discover for Banque Nationale → avature ok, count>0, quality='fragile'; Bell + Air Canada → phenom fragile ok; HDR with Taleo URL → taleo fiable; Desjardins workday fiable (regression). (2) POST /api/careeros/radar/portal/detect correctly returns kind=taleo for hdr.taleo.net URL, kind=avature for emplois.bnc.ca/.../SearchJobs, kind=phenom for jobs.bell.ca/ca/fr/search-results. (3) PUT /api/careeros/radar/settings accepts companies with kind in {taleo, avature, phenom} (pydantic pattern updated) and persists them — snapshotted + restored original settings afterwards. (4) GET /api/careeros/radar/directory now contains Banque Nationale (avature), Bell (phenom), Air Canada (phenom), all ok=true. (5) GET /api/admin/connectors (X-Admin-Password) returns the new fields on supported rows (reliable, fragile, blocked, fallback, fragile_kind:boolean) + top-level 'redetect' dict. Backlog no longer contains bare UKG/Avature/Taleo/Phenom unsupported entries; only SuccessFactors (blocked) remains, as expected. FRONTEND: logged in as the member on the preview URL, dismissed the Privacy banner, opened /careeros/radar — dashboard portal health section renders all four chips [portal-quality-fiable=7, fragile=0, bloquee=0, repli=1]. Opened Réglages, clicked the loupe (data-testid="portal-discover-run-9") on the Bell row (radar-company-9); the discover panel returned 2 Phenom candidates, both with the data-testid="portal-fragile-9-phenom" warning text « Lecture fragile (page web sans API publique) : résultats possiblement partiels, repli Jooble en cas d'échec. » and a working « Associer » button (data-testid portal-associate-9-phenom*). On /admin → Connecteurs tab, the Connecteurs actifs table shows the four new columns « Fiable / Fragile / Bloquée / Repli Jooble » and a sky-blue « au mieux » badge is wired for fragile kinds (not currently rendered because no active member row is of a fragile kind yet — UKG is in the active list but UKG ∉ FRAGILE). The « Désormais pris en charge, à re-détecter » hint (data-testid=connectors-redetect) renders « Phenom (2), Avature (1) » — proof the backlog cleanup migration is live. No console errors on any page.
critical_code_review_comments: radar_sources.py: FRAGILE={'icims','avature','phenom'} — Taleo is correctly NOT fragile (it has a semi-structured JSON endpoint). quality() correctly returns 'bloquee'/'repli'/'fragile'/'fiable' in that priority order.
radar.py Company.kind pattern now accepts taleo/avature/phenom/ukg — pydantic regex matches on PUT /settings; verified via test.

parse_portal() uses a loose regex `host/segment/SearchJobs` that could also match non-avature SearchJobs URLs; however, _scan() + 'avature' text probe in radar_discovery.py protects discovery. Keep an eye on false positives if a non-Avature portal uses /SearchJobs in its path.
connectors.py NOW_SUPPORTED includes 'UKG','Avature','Taleo','Phenom' — correct; backlog correctly moves these to the 'redetect' bucket and the frontend displays the hint.

The 'au mieux' badge in Connectors.jsx only renders when a kind is both active (members have it) AND in S.FRAGILE. The current preview has no active fragile kind yet (UKG members only); that's expected rather than a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dashboard 4 chips + Bell loupe fragile warning + Associer + admin Connecteurs columns + redetect hint all verified)
